title: Jewish man injured after attack by group of men
originalTitle: Jewish man injured after attack by group of men
content:
A Jewish man in his 20s is being treated in hospital for injuries to his face and back after being attacked by a number of men in north London.

The Metropolitan Police said its officers arrived at the scene within six minutes and said they were treating the incident as an antisemitic hate crime.

The incident took place outside a property on The Grove in Golders Green, north London, at about 02:00 BST on Monday.

No arrests have been made and anyone with information is asked to contact the police, the force added.

The assault is the latest in a spate of attacks on the Jewish community and follows last month's stabbings in Golders Green, north London.
